policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 7 Jan close (1x4 3.77, 3x6 3.55, 6x9 3.36, 9x12 3.32 vs WIBOR 3M 3.98) price roughly 65bp of NBP cuts within 12 months. The NBP survey of professional forecasters (2 Jan) sees an average reference rate of 3.69% in 2026. PKO (7 Jan): derivatives price a 3.25% reference rate by mid-2026; Deutsche Bank Polska (7 Jan) expects a January hold with core CPI at ~2.8%.
policy.risk_text: MPC members ruled out a January cut in December (Kotecki 10 Dec; Wnorowski and Kotecki 16 Dec). If cuts are pushed out, front-end roll-down does not materialise; PKO (7 Jan) notes that 2Y below 3.75% and 10Y near 5.10% are levels it expected only at end-Q1, and Friday's PLN 8-12bn auction limits the room for further falls.

macro.projection_text: NBP November 2025 projection: CPI 3.7% (2025), 2.9% (2026), 2.5% (2027); December 2025 flash CPI 2.4% y/y.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~6.9% of GDP (MoF plan); 2026 budget deficit cap PLN 271.7bn, gross borrowing needs ~PLN 690bn; Santander (19 Dec) noted the 10Y ASW back near 100bp on global fiscal worries.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: Q1 2026 supply of PLN 75-100bn over 8 auctions; Fitch (27 Feb) and Moody's (20 Mar) reviews with negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP cut six times in 2025 to 4.00% (last on 3 Dec); CPI fell to 2.4% in December (flash, 31 Dec; final on 15 Jan, core estimated ~2.8% by Erste), the NBP projects 2.9% for 2026 (professional forecasters, 2 Jan: 2.6%). Manufacturing PMI fell to 48.5 in December (2 Jan). GDP grew 3.8% y/y in Q3. Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. On 7 Jan POLGBs rallied 5-9bp, led by the front end, while swaps barely moved (Erste); MoF announced the 9 Jan offer (PLN 8-12bn incl. the new 5Y POLSTR floater NZ0331). Abroad: euro-area flash HICP 2.0% (core 2.3%) and an ECB hold priced through 2026; US JOLTS 7.15m (7.65m expected), ADP +41k, ISM services 54.4; UST 10Y 4.14%, Bund 2.81% (7 Jan). FWSZ spent PLN 51.4bn in 2025, ~20bn below plan, possibly shifting the defence impulse into 2026 (Erste, 7 Jan). Street views (December): PKO 1Q26 forecast 2Y 3.75 / 5Y 4.50 / 10Y 5.10 (reached by 7 Jan, PKO); Santander expects higher yields in Q1 on supply and cut repricing; ING says early-2026 trading follows MoF's Q1 issuance.

calendar.plan_text: MoF Q1 2026 financing plan (31 Dec 2025): 8 sale auctions for PLN 75-100bn, one switch auction, possible foreign issuance. January: sale auctions on 9 Jan (PLN 7-12bn), 22 Jan (8-13bn) and 28 Jan (7-12bn); no switch auction in January; 36-week T-bill auction on 16 Jan (PLN 2-4bn). 2026 gross borrowing needs ~PLN 690bn. BGK: FPC to issue domestically in 2026 (up to PLN 18.5bn). 9 Jan offer (MoF, 7 Jan): PLN 8-12bn in OK0128, PS0130, WZ0930, PS0131, NZ0331 (new 5Y compounded-POLSTR floater, 25 Mar 2031), DS1033 and DS1035.
calendar.timing_text: Within each auction week of the Aug 2025-Jan 2026 sample, yields drifted lower into the auction (rally regime) and the auction-day close was the cheapest point relative to the preceding session, so new buying is best executed at the auction-day close (9, 22, 28 Jan) rather than the day before. January supply is front-loaded (PLN 22-37bn across three auctions) after only ~21-23% pre-financing. For the front end the 13-14 Jan MPC is the event: members pre-announced no January cut, so a hold is the base case; the December final CPI (15 Jan) and the February/March meetings drive the cut timing.

core_text: Regime: the NBP paused at 4.00% with ~65bp more priced, the ECB is done at 2.00%, the Fed and BoE are easing gradually, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 59bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 234bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 7 Jan close; ~10bp less here on DS1035 vs the Bundesbank fitted 10Y). Euro-area December HICP 2.0% (core 2.3%) on 7 Jan; UST 10Y 4.14%, Bund 2.81%.
